name: Boku Igai no Otoko o Shiranai Kanojo ga Hoka no Otoko ni Dakareteita -Kyouiku Jisshuu Saki de Netorareru Kanojo-
original_name: 僕以外の男を知らない彼女が他の男に抱かれていた －教育実習先で寝取られる彼女－
source:
Yoshiyuki's girlfriend, Shiho, returned to her alma mater as a student teacher.  
There, she reunited with her senior, Murase, whom she had admired during her school days—now a fellow teacher.  
Faced with the person she once looked up to, Shiho couldn't help but feel giddy.  
Murase, seeing right through her feelings, began to take advantage of his position as her supervising teacher to get closer to the now beautifully matured Shiho.  
Before long, Yoshiyuki started noticing something off about Shiho.  
She stopped talking about school, avoided making time for the two of them, and gradually became less attentive toward him.  
Yoshiyuki's unease grew when his younger sister, Momoka, who attended the school where Shiho was teaching, told him about Shiho's behavior there.  
Then, one day, while visiting the school for work, Yoshiyuki witnessed something shocking…

translation:
义之的女朋友志保回到了母校担任实习教师。在那里，她与学生时代仰慕的学长——村濑重逢，他现在是一名同事教师。面对曾经仰望的人，志保不禁感到心跳加速。村濑看透了她的心思，开始利用指导教师的身份接近如今美丽成熟的志保。不久，义之开始注意到志保的异样。她不再谈论学校的事，回避两人独处的时间，对他的关注也逐渐减少。当义之在志保任教的学校就读的妹妹桃花告诉他志保在学校的行为后，他的不安加剧了。然后有一天，义之因工作造访学校时，目睹了令人震惊的一幕……
